entity_types.name: Vehicle
entity_types.description: A specific motor vehicle make, model, or year subject to complaints and recalls, excluding individual automotive components and replacement parts.

entity_types.name: Component
entity_types.description: A physical vehicle part, assembly, or integrated automotive system, excluding entire vehicle models and reported failure symptoms.

entity_types.name: Problem
entity_types.description: An abnormal vehicle behavior, malfunction, failure mode, or symptom reported by an owner, excluding the physical automotive component itself.

entity_types.name: Recall
entity_types.description: An official safety recall campaign or stop-sale action issued to remedy a vehicle defect, excluding standard dealership service visits or warranty repairs.

fact_types.description: The reported problem, symptom, or failure mode involves, damages, or manifests in the automotive component.
One reported symptom or failure condition directly induces or triggers another safety problem.
The reported safety problem or failure is experienced by or reported on the vehicle model.
A component is a physical subpart, assembly member, or subassembly of a larger automotive component.
The named component belongs to or is installed in the vehicle model that the document concerns.
The official safety recall campaign applies to, repairs, replaces, or inspects the defective component.
The official safety recall campaign is initiated to remedy or mitigate the reported safety problem or defect.
The official safety recall campaign applies to the designated vehicle model.
